rust_summary: the network id of a registry name (`native_registry_id`), the reverse of `native_registry_name`, so a mod can send the particle, item, entity and sound types a packet carries as numbers.
doc_summary: `native_registry_id(registry, name)` (`host.registry_id`) gives the protocol id of a name in a registry (`minecraft:particle_type`, `minecraft:entity_type`, ...), the reverse of `native_registry_name`; None for an unknown name and while no server is connected. Bundles need "hooks": @API:registry_id@.
